$comment: The type of the house style, shared by every builtin skill as palette.json is: the font each style is drawn in, the type scale, and the style and size of every text role. Slides and documents (whatever their format) both read it, so a role changed here changes in every one. A style is a family as PowerPoint names it (the font's legacy family name, as 'DM Sans Light') plus a bold flag, and the file that draws it (in assets/fonts/; null when not shipped). The original design sets titles in DM Sans 14pt SemiBold with bold on (weight 800), which is not shipped; title uses DM Sans Bold (700), the nearest. Sizes in points. Elements only one medium has (a slide's 53pt presentation title, a document's cover title) keep their sizes in that medium's own spec.

title.use: slide title; a document's section heading (h1)

heading.use: a card's heading; a document's subsection heading (h2)

intro.use: the line under a title that sets up what follows

emphasis.use: a takeaway, a card's subtitle, bold words in body text

closing_title.use: "Thank you" on the closing slide or page

explore_more.use: "Explore more" on the closing slide or page

contact.use: the contact lines on the closing slide or page
